g.inkscape:label: Contours (elevation, toggle layer)
g.desc: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada. Elevation: Natural Resources Canada, Canadian Digital Elevation Model. Elevation: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) bare-earth DEM (public domain). Contours derived from the DEM resampled to a 495 m grid, lightly smoothed, contoured every 250 m and simplified. Overlay for columbia_us_render_v6a.svg: same viewBox, same map-to-poster transform as the river layer.
